summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing entry into a senior secured Loan and Security Agreement with Hercules Capital as administrative and collateral agent and affiliated lenders, providing up to $150 million across five term-loan tranches. Tranche 1-A of $35 million funded at closing; Tranches 1-B ($20 million) and 1-C ($15 million) are optional through mid-2027, while Tranche 2 ($30 million) is milestone-gated and Tranche 3 (up to $50 million) requires lender investment-committee approval. Interest is prime floored at 6.75% plus 2.40%, interest-only through April 2029. No special situation; a routine credit facility.
